short_description: NorthPeak Retail — an omnichannel retailer's stockout-and-markdown rescue. A cold snap left cold-weather apparel sold out in the North while the same styles pile toward markdown in the South. A store-ops app reads governed inventory at low latency, a recovery recommendation ranks the move (transfer / expedite / substitute) per shortfall, and a store manager approves — turning governed lakehouse data into a store-floor action, with the assistant's AI spend bounded and observable.
